docs.summary: Fluent builder for an Origami context menu. Build items, then the system renders it.

members.name: Item
members.signature: public ContextBuilder Item(string label, Action onClick, bool enabled = true, string icon = "", string shortcut = "", bool danger = false, bool on = false, IOrigamiIcon? iconDraw = null)

params.label: Row label.
params.enabled: When false the row is dimmed and non-interactive.
params.icon: Optional text/glyph icon (glyph font may be empty — prefer `iconDraw`).
params.shortcut: Optional trailing keyboard hint, e.g. "Ctrl D", "F2", "Del".
params.danger: Render the row in the danger (red) colour.
params.on: Render the row in the active/accent colour (the `.on` variant).
params.iconDraw: Optional leading icon, drawn tinted to the row's current text colour.

docs.summary: Add a non-interactive uppercase section header at the top of a group.

members.signature: public ContextBuilder Title(string text, string icon = "", IOrigamiIcon? iconDraw = null)

docs.summary: Add a non-interactive title row (the subject of the menu, e.g. the clicked item's name), shown prominently in normal case with a divider beneath it.

Add a row whose content `draw` builds every frame, for controls such as fields and sliders. It fills the menu width and clicking inside it leaves the menu open.
